| rpg        |  77 134 B |    42 |   103 145 B |   223 | 97    | 5/5   | `4769735236ec8fba` |
| fps        |  74 947 B |    40 |   109 973 B |   234 | 95    | 5/5   | `c034bd9d4b9bb765` |

`QS` = Masterpiece quality score (must be ≥ 85 to pass).
`GP` = target-specific gameplay requirements satisfied (e.g. `5/5` = all
five obby anchors present). Missing requirements are **blocking criticals**
and dock the quality score by 20 each, so `QS 97` cannot coexist with a
missing gameplay anchor.

### World Generator v2 — what every target now produces

| Target     | Recognizable gameplay skeleton                                                            |
|------------|------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| obby       | 5 stages · 5 Checkpoints · 5 Killbricks · 3 Movers + 1 Spinner · FinalGate                |
| tycoon     | TycoonPlot + 4 Dropper→Conveyor→Collector loops · 3 Upgrade pads · Claim podium · walls   |
| simulator  | 3 tier rings (Bronze/Silver/Gold) × 5 ResourceNodes · SellZone · UpgradeShop + PetShop · Prestige |
| rpg        | TownSquare · 4 buildings (Inn/Smithy/Market/Temple) · 4 NPC stands · QuestBoard · DungeonGate     |
| fps        | Two-team arena (Blue/Red) · Spawn pads + Flags + WeaponLockers · 3 lanes × 4 Cover · CapturePoint |

CollectionService tags emitted (uppercase) at runtime via the generated
`AF51SceneBuilder.server.lua` so kits (`ObbyKit`, etc.) auto-discover the
world. Instance attributes (Stage, Axis, Speed, Distance, Phase, Income,
Tier, Team, Reward, …) attached via `:SetAttribute` so kits never have to
parse string values.

Each ZIP rebuilds to an **identical SHA-256** across runs — same input → same
bytes, no timestamps, no entropy. Verified in `scripts/rbx-verify.mjs`
(55 checks: 5 targets × 11 checks each).

## ZIP Contents (verified per target)

```
AF51.rbxlx                                              ← Studio double-click target

production-quality-report.json                          ← class coverage, asset count
ghost/lineage.json                                      ← Ghost Seal signature
ghost/recovery.map                                      ← lineage tracking

src/ServerScriptService/...                             ← server scripts
src/StarterPlayer/StarterPlayerScripts/...              ← client scripts
```

---

## Pipeline (16 stages)

```
 1  TARGET_RESOLVE      → tunnista target + profile
 2  PROFILE_RESOLVE     → development | production
 3  WORKSPACE_PREPARE   → build-root setup
 4  ASSET_INVENTORY     → inventaario
 5  POLICY_GATE         → governance check
 6  TEMPLATE_RESOLVE    → target-template binding
 7  VISUAL_PRODUCTION   → renderer → scenegraph.json
 8  RBXLX_EMIT          → scenegraph.json → AF51.rbxlx  ★ Studio entry
 9  ROJO_EXPORT         → src/ tree + default.project.json
10  RUNTIME_INJECT      → AF51Runtime moduulit
11  QUALITY_REPORT      → class coverage + audit
12  GHOST_SEAL          → lineage + recovery.map
13  MANIFEST_WRITE      → manifest.json
14  ZIP_HARDEN          → byte-stable archiver
15  AUDIT_FINALIZE      → AL-objektit
16  EXPORT_PUBLISH      → exports-rbx/<name>.zip
```

Fail-fast: yksi vaihe pielessä → koko build hylätään, ei osittaisia
artefakteja.

## Studio Entry Flow

Käyttäjäpolku tehtaan ulostulosta Studioon:

```
npm run rbx:build:rpg
  → exports-rbx/AF51-RBX-AF51-RPG-<buildId>.zip
  → pura
  → tuplaklikkaa AF51.rbxlx
  → Roblox Studio aukeaa scenen kanssa
```

Ei Rojoa, ei Open Cloudia, ei API-tokeneita. Local-first.

---

## Known Boundaries

- **Palanen 4** (oletuspalveluiden Camera/StarterPlayer/Players esivalmistus
  rbxlx-puuhun) ei ole vielä toteutettu. Vaikutus selvitetään Studio-smokessa:
  jos Studio antaa Output-paneeliin latausvirheitä näistä, palanen 4
  toteutetaan. Tällä hetkellä `RBXLX_EMIT` tuottaa pelkän Workspacen +
  ReplicatedStorage + ServerScriptService -puun.
- **Ei pilvilataajaa.** Tehdas tuottaa vain paikallisia ZIPejä; Roblox Open
  Cloud -integraatio on tarkoituksellisesti pois.
- **Esitteen v62-PDF-päivitys** on user-puolella; spec annettu erikseen.

---

## Reproducing This Report

```bash
npm install
npm run rbx:verify          # 55 checks, 5 targets × byte-stability
npm run rbx:build:all       # 5 ZIPiä exports-rbx/:ään
sha256sum exports-rbx/*.zip # vahvista SHA:t tämän raportin taulukosta
```

Sama input ⇒ samat SHA:t. Mikäli ZIP-SHA poikkeaa tämän raportin arvosta,
joku tehtaan ydin-tiedostoista on muuttunut.
